Langkah 2: $V = 0.2\text{ mol} \times 24.5\text{ L/mol}$.
Langkah 3: Petungan ngasilake $V = 4.90\text{ L}$.

20261122-chemistry-g12-1.steps.0.prompt: [H3 Panaliten Kimia] Masalah volume gas gegandhengan karo Kesetimbangan kimia lan laju reaksi. Ing $25^\circ\text{C}$ lan $1\text{ atm}$, volume molar gas yaiku $24.5\text{ L/mol}$. Ing kahanan sing padha, pira volume ing $\text{L}$ saka $0.2\text{ mol}$ gas iki?
20261122-chemistry-g12-1.steps.0.explain:
Langkah 1: Miturut hukum Avogadro, volume $V = n \times V_m$.
Langkah 2: $V = 0.2\text{ mol} \times 24.5\text{ L/mol}$.
Langkah 3: Petungan ngasilake $V = 4.90\text{ L}$.
